name: Zottegem Saturday Open 2024
information:
This is a twin competition together with [Zottegem Sunday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ZottegemSundayOpen2024)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZzhYIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--63de4aa9b1fe90f9c4af2cc3b2e86ed03f17ffda/warning.png) 
#You can only compete on Saturday OR on Sunday.
#You can NOT compete in both competitions.

A part of your registration fee will be donated to charity. Please see the ["Goede doel" tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ZottegemSaturdayOpen2024#47303-goede-doel-think-pink) for more info.
